faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BMC Staff Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the BMC Staff Nurse (Paricharika) recruitment is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Staff Nurse (Paricharika) post in the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Staff Nurse position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th (10+2), possess a GNM Diploma, be registered with the Maharashtra Nursing Council, have passed Marathi with 50 marks, and hold a computer certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is between 18 years and 38 years, with relaxation available for backward class candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the BMC Staff Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 1027.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Staff Nurse role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Staff Nurse (Paricharika) post will receive a salary of Rs. 30000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the BMC Staff Nurse vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the creation of a Merit List based on final year marks and subsequent Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided up to 43 years for backward class candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article.
